instructions: You are reading saved web pages about ONE wedding venue in Spain. The pages may also mention other, similar venues: ignore them. Only fill a field if the text states it; otherwise leave it null. Never guess, and never infer from photos. Copy prices as written, in the currency shown; do not convert. Numbers may use a comma as the decimal separator: 148,45 means 148.45.

max_guests.description: Largest number of wedding guests the venue says it can host, for example from up to 250 guests. A whole number.

live_band_allowed.description: true if the page says live bands or live music are allowed; false if it says they are not.

open_bar_available.description: true if an open bar or drinks package is offered or included; false if the page says there is none.

has_pool.description: true if the venue has a swimming pool; false if the page says there is no pool.

sleeps_on_site.description: Number of guests who can sleep at the venue (sleeps N). 0 if the page says there is no on-site accommodation.

bring_your_own_drinks_allowed.description: true if couples may bring their own alcohol or drinks; false if the page says they may not.

outside_catering_allowed.description: true if external caterers are allowed; false if catering is in-house or exclusive only.

curfew.description: Time the music or party must end, as 24-hour HH:MM (2am is 02:00). none if the page says there is no curfew.

venue_hire.description: Venue hire or exclusive-use fee as written, with the currency of its symbol (EUR for the euro sign, GBP for the pound sign). Do not convert.

catering_pp.description: Catering or menu price per person as written (the lowest if several), with its currency. Do not convert.

bar_pp.description: Separate bar or drinks package price per person, with its currency. 0 if the page says drinks are included in the menu price.
